Cumulative usage through 25 Sep is 9,976.70; minus the 600 credit on 18 Sep gives net 9,376.70 (below). Adding 26 Sep's 223.30 gives exactly 9,600.00, which is 'at or above', so the alert fires at the end of 26 Sep. Counting tax gives 24 Sep, ignoring the credit gives 25 Sep, and a strict '>' gives 27 Sep.
